name: Dealer Insights
description:
Dealer Insights connects your AI assistant directly to your dealership's marketing data. Ask questions in plain English and get answers grounded in your real numbers — website traffic, Google Ads and Meta campaign performance, inventory health, vendor performance, phone call activity, SEO rankings, and more.

Instead of logging into five dashboards or waiting on a vendor report, just ask: How did my Google Ads perform last month? Which vehicles are shoppers viewing most? What share of my traffic is mobile? Is my conversion tracking working? Which models am I over-advertising?

Built for dealers, GMs, and dealer-group operators:

• Website & shopper behavior — traffic, device mix, engagement, lead conversions, CTA and form performance • Advertising — Google Ads and Meta performance, budgets and pacing, keyword quality, wasted spend • Inventory — current stock, aging, photo and price issues, sold-vehicle history, feed health • Vendors — how every advertising source is performing, with budget recommendations from Dealer Insights' analysis • Group rollups — compare stores, group-wide traffic and device mix (for dealer-group admins) • Reports & alerts — monthly and weekly reports, diagnostics, active alerts

Every tool is read-only: your AI can look, never touch. Authentication uses OAuth — your Dealer Insights credentials are never shared with the AI provider. Requires an active Dealer Insights account (dealerinsights.com).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dealer Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dealer Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dealerinsights.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dealer Insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dealer Insights lists 46 MCP tools, including analyze_model_performance, compare_stores, get_ad_campaign_performance, get_ad_group_performance, get_benchmarks, get_budget_pacing, get_budget_plan, get_call_activity, get_campaign_daily_trends, get_campaign_insights, get_campaign_mapping_audit, and get_core_models.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dealer Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dealer Insights in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Dealer Insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dealer Insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dealer Insights is developed by Dealer Insights, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
